subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
By the county each hospital sits in, as CMS records it.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Erlanger Murphy Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Erlanger Health System hospitals; Erlanger Medical Center has the most, 5,970. About 14.2 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Erlanger Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other Erlanger Health System hospital reports more; Erlanger Murphy Medical Center is next at 355. About 9.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Erlanger Bledsoe Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Erlanger Health System hospitals; Erlanger Medical Center has the most, 5,970. About 6.9 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Erlanger Medical Center in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Erlanger Health System run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: Tennessee 2 and North Carolina 1. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.
